sections.heading: Battle card: AI-ready design systems (1 page, v1, 21 Oct 2026)
sections.text: In one line: AI will build your clients' interfaces anyway. We make sure it builds *theirs*: on-brand, accessible, consistent.

sections.heading: Listen for these triggers
sections.text:
Trigger · What you hear

AI coding rollout · "We're rolling out Copilot / Cursor / Claude Code to all teams"
Vibe-coded drift · "Product prototypes in AI tools now, but it doesn't look like our app"
Rebrand / M&A / multi-brand · "We're merging brands" · "every product looks different"
Re-platform · "We're moving to React / a new front-end stack"
Accessibility (EAA, in force since 28 Jun 2025) · "We need to be compliant across all our apps"
Understaffed DS team · "Our design-system team is two people" (61% of DS teams lack people, zeroheight 2026)

sections.heading: Ask these 10 questions
sections.text:
1. Who builds UI in your company today, and how many of them use AI tools?
2. When AI produces a screen, how do you know it follows your design system?
3. Do you have one design system, several, or none that people trust?
4. Do Figma and code agree? Who decides when they don't?
5. Could an AI tool read your design guidelines today, or are they PDFs and wiki pages?
6. Who approves changes an AI makes to shared components?
7. How many products and brands share the same UI foundation?
8. What happened the last time your brand or accessibility rules changed?
9. Is there a budget or a programme for AI in product development this year?
10. If we could show you in 2 weeks where you stand, who would want to see it?

Free entry points: the AI-readiness scorecard (10 min) → a 30-min readout.

sections.heading: Objections
sections.text:
They say · You say

"We already have a design system." · "Great, that's the best starting point. The question is whether AI can *read* it. The scorecard shows that in 10 minutes."
"AI tools will handle consistency." · "They guess. Without names, rules and checks they guess differently every time. We give them what they need so they stop guessing."
"No budget." · "The 2-week audit is small and tells you exactly where rework is coming from. Many clients fund the next step from what it finds."
"Our engineers can do this." · "They can, and we work alongside them. Our edge is having done it across many enterprises, with ready tools (MCP, checks, templates)."
"Isn't this just Figma's job?" · "Figma's agent follows *your* library. If the library isn't ready, it follows a mess faster."

sections.heading: Show (internal only unless marked)
sections.text:
- 10-min demo on the fictional demo brand. Never use client brands.
- Proof: Case Studies deck (Datto, Verizon, RMS, New Balance), once cleared for that client.
- Bring Raquel in: problem form · "Ask the account" (48-h memo) · Teams "Ask the DS practice".
